launcher_context.observed: Leader snapshot is waiting with libjli CallJavaMainInNewThread+0x6f in its native stack. report.source_review: Do not await the runOnThread Promise or unload the old script before successful exec preparation; that can wait for a callback that never returns. Use host EXEC transition and supervisor terminal result. For failed exec the callback returns normally, allowing explicit unload. Cooperative native calls release the JS mutex; reviewed Stalker.flush does not establish an inevitable callback-return deadlock.
